packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.t.note: Request side ported: ResolvedOpenAICompletionsCompat with detectCompat/getCompat; convertMessages through transformMessages (tool-call id normalization, thinking replay fields and reasoning_details, the four requires* flags, grammar tool calls, Kimi mid-conversation tools); convertTools with grammar custom tools; buildParams in upstream field order (prompt cache key/retention, empty tools for tool history, tool_stream, Anthropic cache markers, priority, every thinkingFormat with the clamped budget, OpenRouter/Vercel routing, sampling overrides); streamSimple option mapping, cache retention and session-affinity headers (openai-completions-provider.bend runs stream). Byte-identical to upstream on the named suite cases and 724 generated requests (tests/openai_completions_request_check.py). Gaps: the stream fold has no finish_reason fallback (models with supportsFinishReason false are refused) and does not parse custom (grammar) tool-call deltas (requests declaring grammar tools are refused before sending), ignores streamed reasoning_details, and records every reasoning delta under reasoning_content instead of the field that carried it; GitHub Copilot dynamic headers and onResponse are not wired.
